description: Chris Stylez reference track, recorded in late 2017 and sent to Kanye in early 2018, though it's unknown if he ever recorded for it. So that night I pull up at some penthouse in West Hollywood. Pure vibes. Killer view. I make myself some throat coat tea, and we get to work... Next day, they tell me Ye loves the record, don't play this for anyone. I'm like, "Fuck, my first big placement is a Kanye record?!" I get called a couple days later later, and it's to lay vocals for another song, 'Brothers'."
